title: Tulfo urges OFWs in France, Saudi Arabia, Israel to stay vigilant

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Erwin Tulfo urged overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in France, Saudi Arabia and Israel to take extra precautions amid reports of chaotic incidents such as violent unrest, attacks and security threats in the three countries.
